hero.subheading: A peace of Namibia just for you. Feel at home on Elkana a luxury self-catering loge in the middle of natures tranquility.

backgroundImage.alt: A drone shot of the three elkana units and the sunset view

aboutUs.body: Enjoy the silence of an exclusive self-catering lodge. No other guest will be present for the duration of your stay. An unique opportunity to feel at home, far away from home. The entire property is yours. Namibia's nature meets comfort and style, offering a modern, luxurious setting with a fully equipped kitchen, including an oven, coffee machine, fridge, dishwasher, and complete crockery and cutlery for up to 14 guests. Enjoy yourself with in the outdoor barbecue and pizza oven area, relaxing at the pool and in the evenings start a fire under the open sky. You will experience a breath taking landscape.
